email.subject: Saltwater Hair Studio: no booking link, no tap-to-call
email.body:
Hi Kofi,

I looked at Saltwater Hair Studio's site. Two things are likely costing you clients: there's no online booking, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next salon, and your phone number isn't clickable on mobile, so people have to copy it by hand before calling. The site also isn't optimized for phones, has no reviews shown, and the footer still lists an old year.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainers. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's broken and what fixing it would take?

Alex
Northlight Web
